anchors.finding: Shop mounts the inline account gate and current CommerceCheckout.
Redirect/result route mounts recovery CommercePayment, no query-result proof or automatic restoration confirmation.
Canonical order route hosts owner-gated admissions; it is not a new settlement writer.

Fresh member gate plus identity state/generation isolates changed accounts. Hidden children remain mounted; own-ID classification is not the entire readiness contract. Checkout keeps shipping draft in React state.

SessionStorage contains identifiers only; discovery is abortable. Restored checks are manual, SDK return confirms once. Hook/direct official branches, browser lock, active-only completion guards and exact matching-pointer cleanup are current behavior.
Read-only own-account GET returns bounded non-PII unresolved metadata; ordinary succeeded history is excluded, conflicts remain discoverable; >100 stops rather than truncating.
Installed confirm hook requires its current cartID, spreads additionalData after defaults, consumes error text or response JSON; it does not expose typed native header/body classification.

Wrapper validates browser mutation/body and runs risk preflight before generated confirm. Signed webhook capability skips browser policy; deferred risk flush follows handler return/rejection. Current errors are broad.
Confirmation requires active PostgreSQL session, exact snapshot/account/store/channel, clear PAID evidence and locked reservation reread; official finalizeOrder is the sole settlement call.

Bounded signed raw-body verification, store/origin and process-local abuse checks precede same-native-request official handler dispatch. WeakSet capability/data/user/text restored in finally; event body is not paid proof.
Explicit resume verifies row/account/config, fetches once and rereads snapshot/status. Exact FAILED suggests retirement; typed missing can return same-ID SDK request; other states status-only.

Preflight and deferred second-read evidence use independent review transaction; exact risk holds/late-payment conflicts cannot be cleared. Clear preflight validates PAID; unsupported/FAILED is not a typed automatic failure path today. Durability is qualified by installed transaction layer.
Only exact identity/total and TEST-channel provider evidence can settle or quarantine. Minimal projection strips unrelated payload; full-cancel/hold/clear differ.

Retirement is explicit: own independent transaction, locked current no-order/no-hold/no-conflict and exact FAILED/zero-paid proof before release; already-terminal no-op is not new evidence of nonpayment.
Transaction terminal and hold guards; on first succeeded transition, active same-request settlement settles reservation and grants admissions. Official cart/order hooks preserve snapshot/history.

Official handler owns transaction init/commit/kill and one finalize call. Atomic pending claim, canonical replay lookup, order/cart/inventory/succeeded writes. Local 25/500 ms settlement polling is NOT a provider finality/reconciliation timing policy.
Request-private write scopes; canonical verified email/active membership, same-origin read/mutation controls and bounded process-local rate guard; not distributed/public-ingress acceptance.

Attempt/resource locks bind snapshots and net-three/capacity counters. Settle moves reservations to paid/committed; verified release reasons preserve used-benefit history and never automatically restock physical goods.
Paid grant checks settled reservation/snapshot and transaction identity, validates complete replay and buyer-self occupancy. Partial/corrupt grants stop; no result reader should recreate them.

Lifted native done promise catches native rejection by calling transactionFailed; after ready has settled this can fulfill the done returned by session.resolve/reject, absorbing transaction-end failure.
Missing session silently returns; deletes session before resolve, and catches resolve rejection to invoke reject.
Missing session silently returns; deletes session then awaits lifted reject, not a separate guaranteed rollback acknowledgement.
Awaits adapter commit then deletes req.transactionID; deletion is not proof native COMMIT succeeded.
Ignores promise-valued transactionID, swallows rollback errors and deletes concrete request transactionID.

Reused native GET transport has an existing 5-second timeout and recognizes typed 404 only after JSON consumption. Generic 404, transport/body failure or invalid provider body throws. Legacy ingress is 410, not another payment authority.
Installed filter/status type lists PENDING; not evidence of wire-alias equivalence.
Installed response variant uses PAY_PENDING and has provider transactionId; this is not evidence selected CARD can safely retry.
Browser SDK txId is a per-request attempt identifier, distinct from paymentId and Payload transaction UUID.
Webhook transactionId may differ across attempts under one payment; current project webhook dispatch chooses its own plugin tuple from paymentId.
Real session/advisory locks and unchanged non-claim API completion path. Claim-only opt-in native callback/sentinel ownership is not used by payments; do not infer its tests repair financial callers.
Transaction reader verifies exact UUID/hex32 payment mapping and immutable snapshot. Initiation uses attemptID hash idempotency and reservation creation, not automatic charge authority.
Strict shipping/commerce snapshot includes owner, cart, product/release/event, quantity/currency/arithmetic, price/event versions and address.
Parsed ordered snapshot hash binds immutable charge identity.
Bounded native JSON reader stabilizes validated text for official handler; preserve body-size/deadline/type boundaries.
Installed Drizzle native transaction awaits callback then COMMIT, attempts ROLLBACK on exception and rethrows; native SQL completion differs from the lifted API promise.
Risk projection holds/revokes unused benefits while retaining consumed attendance/redemption audit.
Guest operations choose native claim-only helper versus ordinary commerce transaction for non-claim operations; buyer admissions GET reads own order, not settlement.

Existing tests explicitly prohibit restored confirmation/SDK auto-launch; proposed automatic status reconciliation revises only confirmation part and retains no-launch invariant. Other tests cover stale identity and browser faults; not run in this design.
Adapter tests mock finalizer/transaction storage and count one adapter provider read; not full endpoint two-read or native durability proof.
Own unresolved projection/privacy/terminal conflict source tests; inspected, not executed.
Risk and second-GET/late-PAID mocked transaction tests; inspected, not executed.
Same native request and signature capability source tests; inspected, not executed.
Explicit failed-only retirement tests; inspected, not executed.

Existing opt-in local PostgreSQL acceptance file loads environment and uses DB when enabled; not invoked. Separate approval still required, and existing scenarios are not exhaustive transaction-end fault proof.
